svg.aria-label: End-to-end deployment architecture: GitHub triggers an Azure DevOps pipeline (Validate, BuildAndPush, DeployDev, SmokeTest, E2ETest) that reads secrets from Key Vault, authenticates to AKS as the least-privilege ci-deployer ServiceAccount, and pushes images through ACR. Inside the AKS cluster, ingress-nginx and cert-manager terminate TLS in front of the Angular client, which calls TicketService, ResponseService, and NotificationService; the three services exchange events only through RabbitMQ. Container Insights streams logs and metrics to Log Analytics.
svg.text: Support Ticketing System — End-to-End Deployment Architecture
BuildAndPush / DeployDev / SmokeTest / E2ETest skipped on PRs
BuildAndPush, DeployDev, SmokeTest, and E2ETest are skipped on pull-request-triggered runs — only Validate gates a PR.
The pipeline deploys as the least-privilege ci-deployer ServiceAccount, never the cluster-admin credential AKS hands out by default.
